title: ㅎ 받침 소리 읽기: 좋다는 왜 [조타]예요?
objective: By the end, you can read words like 좋다 [조타] and 많지 [만치] aloud, changing ㅎ + ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅈ into [ㅋ·ㅌ·ㅊ].
summary: Learn how a final ㅎ joins the next ㄱ, ㄷ, or ㅈ to make the strong sounds ㅋ, ㅌ, and ㅊ.

task.title: Read and write the sounds
task.line: Use the ㅎ + ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅈ rules to choose, decide, or write how each word sounds.

words.exampleMeaning: There are a lot of people on weekends, right?
I add milk to my coffee and drink it.
I don't want to get up in the morning.

letters.sound: Final ㅎ and the next ㄱ join into one strong [ㅋ].
letters.as: Like k in 'kite', with a strong puff of air: 좋고 [조코]

letters.sound: Final ㅎ and the next ㄷ join into one strong [ㅌ].
letters.as: Like t in 'top', with a strong puff of air: 좋다 [조타]

letters.sound: Final ㅎ and the next ㅈ join into one strong [ㅊ].
letters.as: Like ch in 'church', with a strong puff of air: 좋지 [조치]

exercises: Choose the correct sound: ① 놓다 → [노다 / 노타] ② 않고 → [안코 / 안고] ③ 노랗지 → [노라지 / 노라치]
Write how each word sounds in [ ]: ① 하얗다 ② 많고 ③ 잃지
Yes or No: Does this word use the ㅎ + ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅈ rule? ① 많지요 ② 좋아요 ③ 넣지 마세요
Write the sound of the word in ( ): ① 책상 위에 (놓고) 가세요. ② 이 옷 (어떻게) 입어요? ③ 저는 고기가 (싫지) 않아요.
answers: ① Yes [만치요] ② No (the next letter is ㅇ, not ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅈ) ③ Yes [너치]
